title: Pretzel with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffcc44'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc7722'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Pretzel body - outer loop -->
  <path d='M50 20 
           C35 20, 22 30, 22 45 
           C22 55, 28 62, 38 62 
           C45 62, 48 57, 50 52 
           C52 57, 55 62, 62 62 
           C72 62, 78 55, 78 45 
           C78 30, 65 20, 50 20 Z' 
        fill='#cc7722' stroke='none'/>
  <!-- Inner hole overlay -->
  <path d='M50 30 
           C42 30, 33 36, 33 46 
           C33 53, 37 56, 42 56 
           C46 56, 48 53, 50 49 
           C52 53, 54 56, 58 56 
           C63 56, 67 53, 67 46 
           C67 36, 58 30, 50 30 Z' 
        fill='#aa5511' stroke='none'/>
  <!-- Lower loop legs -->
  <path d='M38 62 C34 72, 30 78, 26 82' fill='none' stroke='#cc7722' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 62 C66 72, 70 78, 74 82' fill='none' stroke='#cc7722' stroke-width='9' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Salt crystals -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='44' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='44' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='78' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='1.8' fill='#332211'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='1.8' fill='#332211'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M42 46 Q50 54 58 46' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#ff7766' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#ff7766' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
